mapper.select: SELECT name, array_to_string(allowed_phone_regions, ',') AS allowed_phone_regions, sms_sender_name, timezone, brand_color FROM company_profile WHERE singleton
SELECT name, description, timezone, default_language, brand_color, sms_sender_name FROM company_profile WHERE singleton
mapper.update: UPDATE company_profile SET name = CAST(#{company.name} AS jsonb), description = CAST(#{company.description} AS jsonb), timezone = #{company.timezone}, default_language = #{company.defaultLanguage}, brand_color = #{company.brandColor}, sms_sender_name = #{company.smsSenderName}, updated_at = #{now}, version = version + 1 WHERE singleton
mapper.select: SELECT logo AS png, logo_version AS version FROM company_profile WHERE singleton AND logo IS NOT NULL
SELECT logo_version FROM company_profile WHERE singleton AND logo IS NOT NULL
mapper.update: UPDATE company_profile SET logo = #{png,jdbcType=BINARY}, logo_version = logo_version + 1, updated_at = #{now}, version = version + 1 WHERE singleton
mapper.select: SELECT id, name, address, description FROM branches WHERE status = 'ACTIVE' ORDER BY created_at
SELECT stamps_required, reward_name, reward_description FROM reward_rules WHERE active
SELECT min_interval_minutes, max_stamps_per_day FROM stamp_policies WHERE branch_id IS NULL

SELECT b.id, b.name, b.address, b.business_hours::text AS business_hours, b.status, EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM stamp_policies p WHERE p.branch_id = b.id) AS policy_overridden, b.google_review_url FROM branches b ORDER BY b.created_at
SELECT count(*) FROM branches WHERE status = 'ACTIVE' AND id <> #{excludedId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO branches (id, name, address, business_hours, status, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{id}, CAST(#{name} AS jsonb), CAST(#{address} AS jsonb), CAST(#{businessHours} AS jsonb), 'ACTIVE', #{now}, #{now})
mapper.update:
UPDATE branches SET name = COALESCE(CAST(#{name} AS jsonb), name), address = COALESCE(CAST(#{address} AS jsonb), address), business_hours = NULL COALESCE(CAST(#{businessHours} AS jsonb), business_hours) ,
google_review_url = NULLIF(#{googleReviewUrl}, ''), status = COALESCE(#{status}, status), updated_at = #{now}, version = version + 1 WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT branch_id IS NOT NULL AS overridden, min_interval_minutes, max_stamps_per_day, require_staff_approval, pending_timeout_minutes, enforce_business_hours FROM stamp_policies WHERE branch_id = #{branchId} OR branch_id IS NULL ORDER BY branch_id NULLS LAST LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO stamp_policies (id, branch_id, min_interval_minutes, max_stamps_per_day, require_staff_approval, pending_timeout_minutes, enforce_business_hours, updated_by, updated_at) VALUES (#{id}, #{branchId}, #{policy.minIntervalMinutes}, #{policy.maxStampsPerDay}, #{policy.requireStaffApproval}, #{policy.pendingTimeoutMinutes}, #{policy.enforceBusinessHours}, #{staffId}, #{now}) ON CONFLICT (branch_id) DO UPDATE SET min_interval_minutes = EXCLUDED.min_interval_minutes, max_stamps_per_day = EXCLUDED.max_stamps_per_day, require_staff_approval = EXCLUDED.require_staff_approval, pending_timeout_minutes = EXCLUDED.pending_timeout_minutes, enforce_business_hours = EXCLUDED.enforce_business_hours, updated_by = EXCLUDED.updated_by, updated_at = EXCLUDED.updated_at, version = stamp_policies.version + 1
